name: hand-watercolor-wash
title: Watercolor Wash
description: Nhiều lớp màu nước trong mờ loang rộng dần chồng lên nhau, mép đậm hơn lòng.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Translucent washes stacked: recipe each layer spreads over 2000 ms ease-out at 10-15 % opacity, 200 ms apart. Demo: 5 noisy blobs (50 points, edge +-35 % noise, 1.4 x wider than tall); layer k radius 0 -> 30 + 6k px over 1.8 s easeOutCubic from 0.2 + 0.25k s; fill 16 % plus a 2 px stroke of the same colour so the edges read darker. Params: layers (5) · spread (2 s) · opacity (10–15 %). Each layer spreads over 1.8 s (ease-out cubic), 0.25 s after the last, at 16 % with a stroke of the same colour so the edges read darker.
